def answer_query(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    horse_rider_patches = image_patch.find("horse rider")
    
    # If no horse riders found, return a default answer
    if not horse_rider_patches:
        return "No horse riders found in the image."

    # Sort the horse rider patches by their distance from the center of the image
    center_x = image_patch.right / 2
    center_y = image_patch.upper / 2
    horse_rider_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: math.sqrt((patch.left - center_x)**2 + (patch.lower - center_y)**2))

    # Return the answer to the query
    return f"The horse rider closest to the center of the image is at coordinates ({horse_rider_patches[0].left}, {horse_rider_patches[0].lower})."
